title: All about the Thoroughbred
note: The Jockey Club states that racehorses may race from age two and that two-year-olds often compete in races called Juvenile races. Use for British Flat juvenile-race semantics rather than a global age rule.

title: Pace Makes the Race / Pace Analysis
note: Equibase explains routes as races at a mile or greater around two turns in its pace-analysis material. Use for North American handicapping/race-type terminology only.

title: Fractional Times
note: Equibase publishes fractional times at intermediate points for standard race distances and separates them from final time. Use for North American timing terminology.

title: What is Banei Tokachi?
note: Official English guidance states that Banei Horse Racing uses large draft horses of about one ton pulling an iron sled. Use for the Banei-scoped draft-horse sense rather than a global breed taxonomy.

title: Youth Beats — Standardbred Lingo
note: USTA educational material explicitly defines Barefoot as a horse racing without shoes. Use for North American Harness terminology; shoeing rules remain jurisdiction-specific.
